queries: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio with zero or NULL derived_product_cost is undefined and is excluded from the average; the line item still counts.
